# Packets by direction

Which way each InSim packet travels, as the specification marks it. Receive with
`@insim.on.IS_XXX` what LFS sends; send with `insim.send.IS_XXX(...)` what your program
sends. The editor lists only the packets that fit each one. `insim.on(IS_XXX)` and
`insim.send(IS_XXX(...))` do the same, and `received.IS_XXX` and `sent.IS_XXX` are the
same classes as `lfs_insim.packets.IS_XXX`.

| Packet | Direction | Receive | Send | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `IS_ACR` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_ACR` |  | Admin Command Report - a user typed an admin command - variable size |
| `IS_AIC` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_AIC` | AI Control - variable size |
| `IS_AII` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_AII` |  | AI Info |
| `IS_AXI` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_AXI` |  | AutoX Info |
| `IS_AXM` | both | `on.IS_AXM` | `send.IS_AXM` | AutoX Multiple objects - variable size |
| `IS_AXO` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_AXO` |  | AutoX Object |
| `IS_BFN` | both | `on.IS_BFN` | `send.IS_BFN` | Button FunctioN - delete buttons / receive button requests |
| `IS_BTC` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_BTC` |  | BuTton Click - sent back when user clicks a button |
| `IS_BTN` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_BTN` | BuTtoN - button header - followed by 0 to 240 characters |
| `IS_BTT` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_BTT` |  | BuTton Type - sent back when user types into a text entry button |
| `IS_CCH` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_CCH` |  | Camera CHange |
| `IS_CIM` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_CIM` |  | Conn Interface Mode |
| `IS_CNL` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_CNL` |  | ConN Leave |
| `IS_CON` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_CON` |  | CONtact - between two cars (A and B are sorted by PLID) |
| `IS_CPP` | both | `on.IS_CPP` | `send.IS_CPP` | Cam Pos Pack - Full camera packet (in car OR free view mode) |
| `IS_CPR` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_CPR` |  | Conn Player Rename |
| `IS_CRS` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_CRS` |  | Car ReSet |
| `IS_CSC` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_CSC` |  | Car State Changed - reports a change in a car's state (currently start or stop) |
| `IS_FIN` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_FIN` |  | FINished race notification (not a final result - use IS_RES) |
| `IS_FLG` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_FLG` |  | FLaG (yellow or blue flag changed) |
| `IS_HCP` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_HCP` | HandiCaPs |
| `IS_HLV` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_HLV` |  | Hot Lap Validity - off track / hit wall / speeding in pits / out of bounds |
| `IS_III` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_III` |  | InsIm Info - /i message from user to host's InSim - variable size |
| `IS_IPB` | both | `on.IS_IPB` | `send.IS_IPB` | IP Bans - variable size |
| `IS_ISI` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_ISI` | InSim Init - packet to initialise the InSim system |
| `IS_ISM` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_ISM` |  | InSim Multi |
| `IS_JRR` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_JRR` | Join Request Reply - send one of these back to LFS in response to a join request |
| `IS_LAP` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_LAP` |  | LAP time |
| `IS_MAL` | both | `on.IS_MAL` | `send.IS_MAL` | Mods ALlowed - variable size |
| `IS_MCI` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_MCI` |  | Multi Car Info - if more than MCI_MAX_CARS in race then more than one is sent |
| `IS_MOD` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_MOD` | MODe: send to LFS to change screen mode |
| `IS_MSL` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_MSL` | MSg Local - message to appear on local computer only |
| `IS_MSO` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_MSO` |  | MSg Out - system messages and user messages - variable size |
| `IS_MST` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_MST` | MSg Type - send to LFS to type message or command |
| `IS_MSX` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_MSX` | MSg eXtended - like MST but longer (not for commands) |
| `IS_MTC` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_MTC` | Msg To Connection - hosts only - send to a connection / a player / all |
| `IS_NCI` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_NCI` |  | New Conn Info - sent on host only if an admin password has been set |
| `IS_NCN` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_NCN` |  | New ConN |
| `IS_NLP` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_NLP` |  | Node and Lap Packet - variable size |
| `IS_NPL` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_NPL` |  | New PLayer joining race (if PLID already exists, then leaving pits) |
| `IS_OBH` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_OBH` |  | OBject Hit - car hit an autocross object or an unknown object |
| `IS_OCO` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_OCO` | Object COntrol |
| `IS_PEN` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_PEN` |  | PENalty (given or cleared) |
| `IS_PFL` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_PFL` |  | Player FLags (help flags changed) |
| `IS_PIT` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_PIT` |  | PIT stop (stop at pit garage) |
| `IS_PLA` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_PLA` |  | Pit LAne |
| `IS_PLC` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_PLC` | PLayer Cars |
| `IS_PLH` | both | `on.IS_PLH` | `send.IS_PLH` | PLayer Handicaps - variable size |
| `IS_PLL` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_PLL` |  | PLayer Leave race (spectate - removed from player list) |
| `IS_PLP` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_PLP` |  | PLayer Pits (go to settings - stays in player list) |
| `IS_PSF` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_PSF` |  | Pit Stop Finished |
| `IS_REO` | both | `on.IS_REO` | `send.IS_REO` | REOrder (when race restarts after qualifying) |
| `IS_RES` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_RES` |  | RESult (qualify or confirmed finish) |
| `IS_RIP` | both | `on.IS_RIP` | `send.IS_RIP` | Replay Information Packet |
| `IS_RST` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_RST` |  | Race STart |
| `IS_SCC` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_SCC` | Set Car Camera - Simplified camera packet (not free view mode) |
| `IS_SCH` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_SCH` | Single CHaracter |
| `IS_SET` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_SET` |  | SETup |
| `IS_SFP` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_SFP` | State Flags Pack |
| `IS_SLC` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_SLC` |  | SeLected Car - sent when a connection selects a car (empty if no car) |
| `IS_SMALL` | both | `on.IS_SMALL` | `send.IS_SMALL` | General purpose 8 byte packet |
| `IS_SPX` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_SPX` |  | SPlit X time |
| `IS_SSH` | both | `on.IS_SSH` | `send.IS_SSH` | ScreenSHot |
| `IS_STA` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_STA` |  | STAte |
| `IS_TINY` | both | `on.IS_TINY` | `send.IS_TINY` | General purpose 4 byte packet |
| `IS_TOC` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_TOC` |  | Take Over Car |
| `IS_TTC` | your program sends it |  | `send.IS_TTC` | General purpose 8 byte packet (Target To Connection) |
| `IS_UCO` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_UCO` |  | User Control Object |
| `IS_VER` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_VER` |  | VERsion |
| `IS_VTN` | LFS sends it | `on.IS_VTN` |  | VoTe Notify |

OutSim and OutGauge come by UDP only: `@outsim.on.OutSimPack2`, `@gauge.on.OutGaugePack`.

## Subtypes

`IS_TINY` and `IS_SMALL` carry a subtype (`SubT`). `@insim.on.IS_TINY(TINY.MPE)` accepts
only the subtypes that LFS sends; the others are requests and instructions for
`insim.send.IS_TINY(SubT=...)`.

| Packet | LFS sends | Your program sends |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `IS_SMALL` | `SMALL.VTA`, `SMALL.RTP`, `SMALL.ALC`, `SMALL.LCL` | `SMALL.SSP`, `SMALL.SSG`, `SMALL.TMS`, `SMALL.STP`, `SMALL.NLI`, `SMALL.LCS`, `SMALL.AII` |
| `IS_TINY` | `TINY.NONE`, `TINY.REPLY`, `TINY.VTC`, `TINY.MPE`, `TINY.REN`, `TINY.CLR`, `TINY.AXC` | `TINY.VER`, `TINY.CLOSE`, `TINY.PING`, `TINY.SCP`, `TINY.SST`, `TINY.GTM`, `TINY.ISM`, `TINY.NCN`, `TINY.NPL`, `TINY.RES`, `TINY.NLP`, `TINY.MCI`, `TINY.REO`, `TINY.RST`, `TINY.AXI`, `TINY.RIP`, `TINY.NCI`, `TINY.ALC`, `TINY.AXM`, `TINY.SLC`, `TINY.MAL`, `TINY.PLH`, `TINY.IPB`, `TINY.LCL` |

The ones marked both ways (`TINY.VTC`, `SMALL.ALC`, `SMALL.LCL`) and the keep alive
(`TINY.NONE`) are in the first column, and your program may send them too.
